subject: Short Spark briefing: VP/CTO presence — narrow windows and confirmation

Cc: priya.shah@fathomai.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Short Spark briefing — request for VP/CTO attendance

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the earlier conversation — FathomAI is excited to see how Redwood Inference could reduce per-token cost for our embedded assistants. Wed like to run a compact executive deep-dive that focuses on latency/quantization tradeoffs and a brief technical Q&A.

We know VP/CTO calendars are tight, so wed like to offer two narrow windows next week for a 30-minute exec-to-exec brief + 15 minutes for targeted Q&A:

- Option A: Tue Nov 16, 08:30 09:15 PT (preferred on our side)
- Option B: Wed Nov 17, 12:00 12:45 PT

Who on your side would lead the technical portion? Also: will a VP (product/ops) and the CTO attend both, or should we plan for one exec plus a technical lead?

Ive attached a one-pager and a sketch agenda. If those windows don't work, we can propose an evening slot (Nov 16 after 17:30 PT) but would rather avoid multi-day scheduling if possible.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations, FathomAI
liam.oconnor@fathomai.com

- Ben (ccd) would cover latency/cost tradeoffs on the call.
- Kimberly (ccd) is our CTO lead for partner escalations and can join if the CTO is unavailable.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether your CTO (Priya) will join for the technical Q&A specifically, or should we expect a VP + engineering manager? That helps us tailor the deck and whether we should bring a bench of quantization results.

Our immediate availability:
- Tue Nov 16: 08:30 09:15 PT (works for Chloe + Ben)
- Wed Nov 17: 12:00 12:45 PT (Kim possible but prefers A)

I'll attach our internal runbook (short checklist) and propose a calendar hold once you confirm attendees.
